Capture recent activity logs in local memory for troubleshooting. When enabled, the last 200 log lines are stored and can be copied to your clipboard. Logs are cleared when this setting is disabled.\n\nNote: Logs are NEVER automatically transmitted to the developer or any third party. For troubleshooting assistance, you must manually copy these logs and include them in a GitHub issue or otherwise send them to the developer.
Mirror deletions: If a file is deleted in the source, it will also be deleted in the target during sync.
⚠️ WARNING: This can lead to unintended data loss if source directories are cleared.
Sync To Android Data helps you keep your game saves and app files synchronized between restricted system folders and your cloud-synced storage.\n\nLet\'s get you set up!
The app uses notifications to keep you informed about sync success, failures, and permission issues.

To detect when apps are opened/closed, this app requires Accessibility permissions.

Clicking 'GRANT PERMISSION' should automatically enable this via Shizuku.

If it fails, please follow the manual steps below.

To ensure synchronization works reliably when you open or close apps, we recommend disabling battery optimization for this app.

Since Android devices handle this differently, you may need to find this setting manually in your device's App Info page, and/or look for additional manufacturer-specific battery settings.

You can try clicking the button below to go directly to the optimization settings.
✅ Battery optimization is disabled for this app!
To begin, tap the \'+\' button on the main screen to create a new Sync Entry.
Tap the \'Pencil\' icon to choose the app you want to sync.\n\nSync To Android Data monitors when this target app opens and closes to trigger file syncs.

A Directory Pair defines the two locations to keep in sync.

External Directory:
 • Sync source when app is opened.
 • Generally-accessible location.
 • Tap the folder icon to browse storage.

Internal Directory:
 • Sync source when app is closed.
 • Restricted Android/data location.
 • Tap the folder icon to browse restricted data folders.

Tap \'Save Sync Entry\' to finish. You can toggle sync on/off from the main list, or tap an entry to edit or delete it.\n\nYou can also manually trigger a sync at any time within the Edit Sync Entry page.

Please be cautious when configuring directory pairs. Misconfiguration or failure of dependencies (like Shizuku) could lead to unexpected results.\n\nALWAYS keep a backup of your important data. The developer is not responsible for any data loss incurred while using this app.
Setup is complete. You can now start automating your file synchronization.
